hero.title: Take back your time from the screen.
hero.subtitle: Break helps you block distracting apps and sites, set honest daily limits, and stick with them.

problem.title: The problem
problem.lead: Screens steal hours you never planned to give.
items: You open one app “for a minute” and lose 40 to infinite scroll.
Notifications pull you out of work, study, or a conversation.
Late-night scrolling eats sleep before you notice.
Attention fragments — and the day feels shorter than it was.

consequences.title: If nothing changes
consequences.lead: The cost is quiet, but real.
items: Less deep work and more half-finished tasks.
Worse sleep when the phone is the last thing you see.
People in front of you compete with a glowing rectangle.
Weeks pass with the same “I’ll fix it tomorrow.”

solution.title: The solution: Break
solution.lead: A simple system that blocks what pulls you away — and keeps the limit when willpower fades.

items.title: Site blocking

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.body: Break Web collects the email you use to create an account and payment metadata required to fulfill Break Pro. We do not sell your personal data. Payment is processed by Stripe. For questions, contact support.

terms.title: Terms
terms.body: Break Pro is an annual subscription billed at $49.99 USD unless otherwise stated at checkout. Pro status syncs to the Break iOS app when you sign in with the same email. Refunds follow the store and payment provider policies applicable to your purchase.

support.title: Support
support.body: Need help with your account or Pro status? Email support@break.app with the email you used at checkout. Include your order or session details if you have them.
